import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

# Identify feature types
num_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('num_')]
bin_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('bin_')]
cat_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('cat_')]

# target column
y_train = train['target']
y_val = val['target']

# Prepare features
# For this baseline, we fill numerical NaNs with median and treat categories as categories
X_train = train.drop(columns=['target'])
X_val = val.drop(columns=['target'])
X_test = test

for col in num_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].fillna(X_train[col].median())
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].fillna(X_train[col].median())
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(X_train[col].median())

for col in cat_cols + bin_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype('category')
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].astype('category')
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype('category')

# Train model
model = LGBMRegressor(n_estimators=1000, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=42)
model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, 
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    eval_metric='rmse', 
    callbacks=[]) # Avoid warnings about early stopping if not implemented with a callback

# Predict
preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Save predictions
preds_df = pd.DataFrame({'target': preds})
preds_df.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)
EOF

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv('/app/data/train.csv')
val = pd.read_csv('/app/data/val.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/data/test.csv')

# Identify feature types
num_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('num_')]
bin_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('bin_')]
cat_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c.startswith('cat_')]

# target column
y_train = train['target']
y_val = val['target']

# Prepare features
X_train = train.drop(columns=['target'])
X_val = val.drop(columns=['target'])
X_test = test

# HistGradientBoostingRegressor handles NaNs natively.
# We just need to ensure categories are represented as integers for the 'categorical_features' parameter
all_cat_cols = cat_cols + bin_cols

# Convert categories to codes
for col in all_cat_cols:
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype('category').cat.codes
    X_val[col] = X_val[col].astype('category').cat.codes
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype('category').cat.codes

# Identify indices of categorical features
cat_indices = [X_train.columns.get_loc(col) for col in all_cat_cols]

# Train model
model = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
    max_iter=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    categorical_features=cat_indices,
    random_state=42
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict
preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Save predictions
preds_df = pd.DataFrame({'target': preds})
preds_df.to_csv('/app/predictions.csv', index=False)
EOF
